title: Plumeform from-here-to-there panels
description: On paper: a bold heading on the left, slate copy, a bolder line and an underlined arrow link on the right, then two tall glass panels side by side with a thin teal arrow between them (stacked with a down arrow on phones), and a small centred note. Everything rises in with a soft blur; colour clouds drift behind the panels.
notes: both panels are media slots (the original shows a mock web page and a mock dashboard)
